Straight answers

Questions owners actually ask

Is the prototype really free?
Yes. It's a preview we build to win your business — if it doesn't convince you, there's nothing to pay and nothing to cancel. That's the point of showing it first.
What does the setup fee depend on?
The size of the site and which tools you take — a five-page site with a call button costs less to build than one with online booking and a quote calculator. You get the exact figure in writing with your prototype, before you decide.
Will I rank #1 on Google?
Nobody can promise that, and you should walk away from anyone who does. What we can do is build everything the right way — the searches, the profile, the reviews, the speed — and report honestly on where you stand each month.
I already have a website. Is this for me?
Especially for you. If your current site just sits there — no calls, no bookings, invisible on Google — the prototype shows you the difference on your own phone before you spend anything.
What if I want to leave later?
The monthly service cancels with notice. Your domain and your Google listing are yours — they're registered in your name from day one.
Do I need to understand any of the tech?
No. You run your business; we run the site, the monitoring and the report. The report is written for owners, not programmers — calls, bookings, and what happens next.
